records.subject: spec-guard-codex-cli
evidence: result:the marketplace ref in ~/.codex/config.toml moved from v0.60.4 to v0.61.0; the installed manifest reads 0.61.0 and its hooks.json carries both entries; the smoke run exited 0

records.subject: spec-guard-0.61.0-codex-trust
evidence: command:codex exec with model_auto_compact_token_limit=40000 in an enabled temporary project, before trust

result:before trust: the existing user_prompt_submit trust record was unchanged and the stage hint was injected as before; four compactions happened and the new SessionStart entry did not run (only other plugins' SessionStart hooks ran); nothing failed
command:codex (interactive), run by the user in the Terminal panel

result:Codex showed "Hooks need review -- 1 hook is new or changed"; the user trusted it; ~/.codex/config.toml gained exactly one record, [hooks.state."spec-guard@spec-guard-marketplace:hooks/hooks.json:session_start:0:0"] with a trusted_hash, and the user_prompt_submit record stayed as it was

records.subject: spec-guard-0.61.0-codex-copy
evidence: result:green from the installed copy (308 cases)
command:codex exec -s workspace-write -c model_auto_compact_token_limit=40000 "<cat eight files, then quote the reminder>", after trust
result:four compactions in one turn; after each one the rollout holds a developer message with the spec-guard stage hint ending in the reminder sentence; the session quoted the sentence verbatim
result:the trust entry codex exec added to ~/.codex/config.toml for the temporary directory was removed by restoring the copy taken right after the user's trust
